subject: png () device error when running poppr function plot = TRUE

messages.author: 163637736dcde11d
messages.subject: png () device error when running poppr function plot = TRUE
parts:
Hi, please help - I do not understand what this error means.

I run the code in an R Notebook file

```{r}
AoAll
summary(AoAll)
AoAll.lt <- locus_table(AoAll)
AoAll.lt
AoAll.poppr <- poppr(AoAll, sample = 999, method = 1, missing = "ignore", plot = TRUE, minsamp = 10, legend = TRUE)
```
and get this as inline output.

Can you please steer me in the right direction as to fixing the error 
Error in (function (filename = "Rplot%03d.png", width = 480, height = 480,  : 
  unable to start png() device

I have tried clean reinstall of R and RStudio, and all my libraries.
If the code is run in the console window, the error is not thrown.

Any help would be greatly appreciated. I'm stumped.
Warmest regards, love what poppr has done for my analyses!
